newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold closes at day's high in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Gold closes at day's high in Hong Kong.

text.p: Gold closed at the day's high on Friday on physical demand and overseas buying, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$341.70/342.20 an ounce against New York's US$340.75/341.25 close on Thursday and Hong Kong's previous close of US$343.60/344.10.

"Market players were short-covering, believing that gold had seen its lowest point and was recovering," said a dealer at a local investment house. "But the direction remained slightly confused, with sentiment still leaning towards bearishness."
Gold would range-trade between $338 and $348, traders said. Near-term support was still seen at $338.
Local gold ended HK$7 lower at HK$3,171 a tael.
